Διδυμαῖος, ὁ, a name of Zeus as worshipped at Didyma in Miletus jointly with Apollo, ; of Apollo, A (so Διδυμεύς, ὁ, of Apollo, ); τὸ Διδυμαῖον,
their temple at Miletus, :—Διδύμεια, τά, their festival there, , al. (Branchidae), .
